title: Paradise Road Status: Open, traction tires advised, gate closing at 3 p.m.
description: 11/15/2026 The road is open to Paradise. Traction tires are advised. All vehicles, including 4WD and AWD, must carry tire chains and be ready to use them. The gate at Longmire to Paradise will close to uphill travel at 3 p.m. and downhill travel at 4 p.m. to support public safety. Due to weather conditions, we may implement an early road closure.

title: Seasonal Closure for Public Access
description: Governors Island National Monument Seasonal Closure The last day of the 2026 visitor season at Governors Island National Monument will be October 31, 2026. Effective November 1, 2026, the monument will be closed to the public for the winter season. The monument is scheduled to reopen on Memorial Day weekend 2027. We thank you for your interest in Governors Island National Monument and look forward to welcoming visitors back in 2027.

title: The Virgin River Narrows closed to top-down travel
description: The Virgin River Narrows is closed to top-down travel due to high water. The lower section of the Narrows from Big Spring down and canyons leading into this section are now open.

title: Buffalo Point Ranger Station - Winter Hours
description: Starting Monday, November 16, the Buffalo Point Ranger Station will be closed Mondays through Fridays over the winter. The station will be open on Saturdays and Sundays, 8:30 am - 4:00 pm. On Monday, March 15, 2027, the station will open back up on some weekdays. To contact the park, please call the Tyler Bend Visitor Center at 870-439-2502 through the winter.

title: West Traps Pasture Hiking Trails Closed Until December 4
description: Bison have been moved from Windmill pasture to West Traps pasture for resource management work. West Traps hiking trails (Davis Trail and Schoolhouse Spur) are temporarily closed to hiking. Please obey posted signs for your safety.

title: Gun Deer Season Closures (Nov. 21-29)
description: Temporary closures will affect multiple Ice Age Trail segments during Wisconsin's nine-day gun deer season, Nov. 21-29. Closure locations, dates, and access conditions vary by segment. Before hiking, review current alerts for segment-specific closure and reroute information. Hunters and hikers may share nearby lands during this period. Wearing blaze orange is strongly recommended where hunting is permitted. Observe all posted closure signs and respect restricted areas. For maps and additional details:

title: Trail Ridge Road is Closed to Through Travel for the Season
description: Trail Ridge Road is closed on the east side of the park at Many Parks Curve and on the west side at Colorado River Trailhead. Trail Ridge Road is not designed as an all-season road. The road typically reopens to through travel during the last week of May, weather permitting. For the latest information on the status of Trail Ridge Road, call 970-586-1222.

title: Current East Rim Trail Status: Open
description: As of Thursday, November 12, 2026, the East Rim Trail System remains open. For more information, visit the website linked below. In good conditions the mountain bike trails are open 6 am-11 pm for bikers and as posted for other trail users. In wet or hazardous conditions, the trail will close to all users to prevent damage. Be flexible; conditions may change throughout the day.

title: Bottomland Nature Trail Closed for Repair Starting November 16th
description: Beginning November 16, 2026 the Bottomland Nature Trail will be closed for maintenance. It will remain closed until further notice. For your safety, please obey all closure signs.

title: Upcoming Hunt Area 2 Closures
description: Hunt Area 2 will be closed several dates due to law enforcement firearms qualifications. It will close at sundown, November 29th, and reopen sunrise, December 2nd. It will also close sundown, December 10th, and will reopen on sunrise, December 12.

title: Closure: Howland Hill Road and Jedediah Smith Campground
description: Starting on November 12, Howland Hill Road and Jedediah Smith Camground will be closed due to severe weather conditions. Additionally, all trails along Howland Hill Road are closed. The road, trails, and campgrounds will reopen when storms have passed, and conditions can be safely assessed.

title: Road conditions 11/13/26
description: The north road remains impassable. The south road continues to dry, and has been graded and smoothed in some of the worst spots. There are some mud puddles, but there are bypasses to drive around them. Mid to high clearance vehicles and experience driving on unpaved roads is recommended. Some GPS units are saying the south road (57/14) is closed but that is NOT true! It just may be impassable for certain vehicle types. Please call for any additional questions or concerns: 505-786-7014.

title: Beach Hazards Statement and High Surf Warning in effect through 11/15
description: Please use extreme caution along the coast, including the beaches of Point Reyes National Seashore, through this weekend. Forecasts are calling for increased risk of sneaker waves, rip currents and dangerously high surf. Breaking wave heights of up to 30 feet are expected. It is highly advisable to stay away from beaches and off of jetties and rocks. Never turn your back to the ocean!

title: Catoctin Mountain Park announces temporary closures November 13 - 15, 2026
description: Due to increased security measures, portions of Catoctin Mountain Park will be closed from approximately noon on Friday, November 13. Closures are scheduled to continue through approximately 8 p.m. on Sunday, November 15, 2026. All trails, parking lots and public use areas will remain open. Park Central Road will be closed between the Hog Rock Parking Lot and the Camp Greentop entrance.

title: East Portal Road closed for winter
description: East Portal Road is closed, and will reopen in spring as conditions permit. East Portal Road reopening is determined by the Bureau of Reclamation.

title: Partial Parking Lot Closure Saturday, November 14, 2026
description: There will be a partial closure of the Overlook Parking lot (72 McBride Ave). The north end of the parking lot will be closed from 7:30am-3:30pm for a construction project. Additional parking is available at the Paterson Museum (2 Market St). The portable toilets will remain accessible. Click on the link for a map of the closed section of the lot.

title: Holiday Hours -- Outdoor Recreation Information Center
description: The Outdoor Recreation Information Center inside the REI Seattle Flagship Store is CLOSED Thursday, November 26th, 2026, for the Thanksgiving holiday, and Friday, November 27th, 2026, for REI's Opt Outside Day.

title: Holiday Hours -- Klondike Gold Rush Visitor Center and Museum
description: The Klondike Gold Rush Visitor Center and Museum is CLOSED Wednesday, November 25, 2026, and Thursday, November 26, 2026, for the Thanksgiving holiday.

title: Park Phone System Outage
description: Due to a phone system issue, the visitor center phone is currently unavailable. Use the contact button below for questions. In case of emergency, dial 911.

title: Lassen National Park Highway Closed to Vehicle Traffic
description: The park road (Hwy 89), is closed to through travel due to accumulated snow. Visitors can enter the park at the northwest entrance and travel 1-mile to the road closure at Loomis Plaza. Or enter the southwest entrance and travel to the road closure at Kohm Yah-mah-nee Visitor Center.

title: Only Box Canyon, DE, and Left Side of Rough Canyon Boat Ramps Are Open
description: Due to low water levels, only Box Canyon, Diablo East, and the left side of Rough Canyon boat ramps are open. The rest are closed. Please use caution with Spur 406 and Spur 454 launches, as the water may be too shallow to launch most boats. To see a list of open ramps, click on "more."

title: Overnight Lodging Suspended and Parkwide Stage 4 Water Restrictions
description: Stage 4 water restrictions continue through Nov. 19, 2026 due to a parkwide water shortage. Overnight lodging is anticipated to resume on Friday, Nov. 20. The park remains open for day use, with food and beverage services, the Grand Canyon Clinic, and Post Office remaining open. Visitors are asked to bring water with them when visiting the park.

title: INNER CANYON TRAIL CLOSURES
description: Current trail closures: the entire North Kaibab Trail (including Cottonwood Campground), Phantom Ranch, Bright Angel Campground, Silver Bridge, and the Black Bridge. Please do not attempt to access the closed areas. Beginning Nov. 18, intermittent trail delays will occur just above 3-Mile Resthouse on the Bright Angel Trail as trail crew continues rockfall mitigation work.

title: Paradise Road Status: Gate closed at Longmire: projected to open tomorrow
description: 11/13/2026: The road is open to Longmire. All vehicles, including 4WD and AWD, must carry tire chains and be ready to use them. The gate at Longmire to Paradise is closed for the night to support public safety and is projected to open, conditions permitting, tomorrow, 11/14/2026 at 9:00 AM

title: Hurricane Ridge Road Closed, Friday 11/13, 4:00pm
description: Hurricane Ridge Road is closed due to forecasted overnight snow.

title: Road to Rim Village is Temporarily CLOSED.
description: The road from Park Headquarters to Rim Village is temporarily CLOSED due to heavy snow from the current weather system. Roads are very slick and covered with slush. Please use extreme caution if driving in the park. All Oregon snow tire and chain laws apply.

title: Old Section Foothills Parkway West new section closed
description: Old Section Foothills Parkway West from Mile Marker 17-31 is closed due to hazardous weather conditions.

title: Tire Chain Restrictions in Effect Due to Snow and/or Ice On Roadways
description: Chain restrictions are in effect on some park roads. All vehicles must carry chains or cables in some areas, including 4WD and AWD vehicles. Install chains when required. For current road information, call (559) 565-3341, (press 1, then 1).

title: Highway 180 to Cedar Grove in Kings Canyon National Park Closed for Winter
description: Highway 180 is closed east of Hume Lake Road for the winter season. Cedar Grove is not accessible by vehicle. This section of road usually reopens in April.

title: Night Work on Carderock Access Bridge over the Clara Barton Parkway
description: Work will be on the nights of November 11 - 13 and November 16 - 20 and will occur from 7 p.m. - 6 a.m. with flaggers present.

title: Beach Hazards, High Surf, & Coastal Flooding November 12-16
description: Coastal flooding due to high tides and beach hazards with increased risk for sneaker waves, strong rip currents and breaking waves of 15-20ft expected. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks. Stay off jetties, rocks, and remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. See detailed weather forecast and NWS link below.

title: Beach Hazards, High Surf, & Coastal Flooding November 12-16
description: Coastal flooding due to high tides and beach hazards with increased risk for sneaker waves, strong rip currents and breaking waves of 15-20ft expected. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks. Stay off jetties, rocks, and remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. See detailed weather forecast and NWS link below.

title: Beach Hazards, High Surf, & Coastal Flooding November 12-16
description: Coastal flooding due to high tides and beach hazards with increased risk for sneaker waves, strong rip currents and breaking waves of 15-20ft expected. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks. Stay off jetties, rocks, and remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. See detailed weather forecast and NWS link below.

title: NPS 300 Road Conditions
description: NPS 300 to Big Tubes is dry. A high clearance vehicle is recommended. The road past Big Tubes is very rough and only accessible to high-clearance, four-wheel-drive vehicles.

title: Use Caution on NPS Trails on the West Side of Lookout Mountain
description: The park is aware of an aggressive barred owl that has been sighted along several trails on the western side of Lookout Mountain Battlefield. While park staff continue to evaluate appropriate management options, visitors are encouraged to stay alert, be aware of their surroundings, and use caution when hiking in this area.

title: Hawk Creek Area Open to the Public
description: The Hawk Creek Area (road, boat launch, campground, and waterway) is now open to the public after a road improvement and stabilization project. Campground reservations are open through November 30, 2026, then closes for the regular winter season closure.

title: Bottle Filling Station and Fountains Across from the Barn Are Closed
description: Due to the low overnight temperatures, the water fountains and filling station are closed for the season, but toilets remain available. Please plan ahead and bring your own water when hiking. Visitor center hours are Wednesday through Sunday, 9 am to 4:30 pm for access to water fountains. The visitor center is closed on Monday and Tuesday from November 1st through March 31st.

title: Construction in the South End of the Park
description: Cottonwood Creek picnic area closed. Mormon Row area open with some construction activity and viewshed impacts.

title: Work Near Pennyfield Lock
description: DC Water is conducting repairs to the Potomac Interceptor near Pennyfield Lock (Lock 22). The parking lot and boat ramp are closed. The closure may remain in effect through November 22, depending on weather conditions. The C&O Canal towpath remains open. For more information contact DC Water.

title: Closures: Detours; Towpath; Points of Interest
description: Multiple items are closed due to hazardous conditions or maintenance. See below for more details.

title: Zion Mount Carmel Highway - Nightly Road Closures
description: Overnight tunnel closures are set for the tunnel on the Zion–Mount Carmel Highway (SR-9) inside Zion National Park starting Monday, Nov. 16 for fiber optic installation. See Utah Department of Transportation website for more information.

title: Archives and Collections Unavailable
description: The Agate Fossil Beds National Monument archive and collections are temporarily unavailable for research or study. If you have a pending research request or have questions, please send an email to scbl_afgo_superintendent@nps.gov and the park will contact you.

title: Prescribed Fire Area Closure - Baker Creek
description: Due to a prescribed burn in the area, the following areas are closed to public access: Pole Canyon, Timber Creek, Baker Creek, and Baker Lake. Call the park for up to date information.

title: Bajada Loop Drive Closure in West District
description: Much of the west district's Bajada Loop Drive is currently closed due to storm damage. Hohokam Road is open to Sus Picnic Area only. The Red Hills Visitor Center remains open, and many trails are still accessible. The east district is fully open.

title: Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road are temporarily closed
description: Tioga Road (continuation of Highway 120 through the park) and Glacier Point Road are temporarily closed due to a forecast of snow. Call 209/372-0200 (then 1, 1) to check road conditions in the park.

title: US 441 / Newfound Gap Road Closed
description: US-Highway 441/Newfound Gap Road from Gatlinburg, TN to Cherokee, NC is closed due to hazardous winter weather conditions.

title: Hilina Pali Road Partial Closure Beyond Maunaiki Trailhead
description: Hilina Pali Road from the Maunaiki Trailhead to the lookout is closed to all use motorized vehicles from 6 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday for shoulder work. Hikers, bicyclists and backcountry permit holders will be given access but should expect delays while heavy machinery works on the road. The work should be complete by 11/30/26. The entire road will be open to all use outside of those hours including weekends and holidays.

title: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive Winter Closure
description: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive is closed to vehicle traffic at Osceola Ditch (4.5 miles up the road) for winter weather.

title: Trail Closure Due to Recent Weather
description: The Bryce Connector Trail (Bryce Point to Peekaboo Loop Trail) is closed until further notice. Other park trails are open, but hikers are urged to use caution. Freezing temperatures overnight can make rockfall more likely during the day.

title: Great Hall, Faneuil Hall Closures: November 2026
description: Due to scheduled events, the Great Hall will close on November 8 and 13. The Great Hall will close at 3pm on November 7 and 21. The Visitor Center Desk on the market floor will remain open.

title: Site Elevator Out of Service
description: The elevator to the historic floor of Hamilton Grange is currently out of service. We apologize for the inconvenience.

title: El Calderon Trail closed for construction through November 2026
description: The El Calderon Trail and parking lot are closed from August 2025 through November 2026 for a major improvement project. NPS Road 100 will remain open for local traffic only, and the Continental Divide Trail will remain open for CDT thru-hikers.

title: Visitor center closed Thanksgiving Day
description: The El Malpais Visitor Center will be closed on Thursday, November 26, for Thanksgiving. The rest of the park is open to visit while the visitor center is closed.

title: Use Caution — Lake Eleven Segment
description: The bridge over the South Fork Yellow River is out on the Lake Eleven Segment. The river is currently crossable, but hikers should anticipate wet feet when crossing. Use caution when evaluating crossing conditions, as water levels and stream conditions may vary. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: Seasonal road closures
description: Heintooga Ridge Road, Parson Branch Road, and Rich Mountain Road are closed for the season.

title: Voice Mailboxes Down
description: Voice mailboxes are down throughout the park, and we cannot receive new voice messages. The issue is being worked on. In the meantime, please email the park for assistance and information at care_information@nps.gov.

title: Campground Amenities Unavailable November 16, 2026 through March 14, 2027
description: All campground amenities (water, electricity, flush restrooms & dump station) at Steel Creek, Kyles Landing, Erbie, Ozark, Tyler Bend, Buffalo Point & Rush will be turned off starting November 16. Camping fees will not be charged over the winter. The flush restrooms at Tyler Bend (Drive-in Loop) and Buffalo Point (B Loop) will remain open. You may still primitively camp in all park campgrounds over the winter, first-come, first-served, but be aware only vault restrooms are open at all other campgrounds.

title: Mineral Bottom and White Rim Road Remain Muddy in Parts, Not Recommended
description: The Mineral Bottom Road switchbacks and west side of the White Rim Road still have slippery and muddy sections due to recent rains. Travel is not recommended until the roads fully dry out.

title: Accessing Fort Barrancas
description: Fort Barrancas is open 9 am–4 pm Wednesday through Sunday. To access Fort Barrancas, visitors will need to enter the Naval Air station Pensacola through the west gate.

title: Montezuma Canyon Temporary Road Closure
description: Montezuma Canyon Rd will be closed to all traffic on November 16-19, 2026 during grading operations taking place between 8:00am and 4:30pm. The park grounds, trails, cave, and visitor center will remain open.

title: Blasting in Memorial
description: Blasting activity is occurring in the Coronado National Forest, Huachuca Mountains, and within Coronado National Memorial. Visitors may hear loud noise and notice dust in the air.

title: Adams Key Closed
description: Adams Key closed due to structural fire — Effective November 7, 2026, Adams Key, including its docks, is closed to all public use for visitor safety. Other park area remain open.

title: Green River Ferry Temporarily Out of Service
description: The Green River Ferry has temporarily suspended operation due to low water levels. Ferry service will resume once water levels rise and conditions are safe. A river forecast is available at: water.noaa.gov/gauges/03309000

title: Tours for 2027 not yet open
description: Reservations for public, guided tours to Honouliuli NHS in 2027 are not yet open. We will announce the dates before the end of the year. Please stay tuned to our website, Instagram, or Facebook for latest updates.

title: Park Store Temporarily Closed
description: The park store is temporarily closed due to flooding following heavy rainfall. We apologize for the inconvenience. National Park Passport stamps remain available at Fort Christiansvaern.

title: The park has a new phone number
description: The park now has a new phone number. Please call: 307-204-6428 for the information line.

title: Stage 1 Fire Restrictions
description: Charcoal fires within enclosed grills are permitted. The use of portable stoves, lanterns using gas, jellied petroleum, pressurized liquid fuel or fully enclosed (sheepherder type) stove in a cleared radius of 15ft of burnable materials are permitted.

title: Trail Access Behind Visitor Center Temporarily Closed
description: Cattle are grazing the West Traps area behind the Visitor Center and gate must remain closed. To access the Scenic Overlook and other western trails, please go up and through the historic ranch headquarters area to access the trails. Trail passes by the large limestone barn, modern restrooms, then winds to the left making a corner at the tin roofed loafing shed. Please pass through the hiking gate adjacent to the cattleguards and not climb over the cattleguards. The gate behind the Visitor Center is closed.

title: Site closure on November 19 & 20, 2026
description: Sand Creek Massacre National Historic Site will be closed on Thursday, November 19 and Friday, November 20 for mandatory staff training. During this time there will be no public access to the site. The site will reopen with regular hours on Saturday, November 21. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Winter Season Closures
description: The following regular winter season road closures are in place: Westside, Paradise Valley, Ricksecker Point, Stevens Canyon, White River, & Sunrise Roads. Closed roads may be open to bicycling when work is not underway on the road. Always check signs on closed road gates before proceeding.

title: Northbound GWMP Lane Closures Between Spout Run and Route 123
description: GW Parkway northbound closures: Spout Run to Route 123, Monday through Thursday, 9:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.; for tree maintenance work continues. Follow posted detours and allow extra travel time.

title: Cascade River Road Closed for the Winter Season
description: Cascade River Road is closed at milepost 21 (Johnson Cabin) two miles before the trailhead. Cascade River Road usually opens in mid-summer depending on snow and road damage. Do not block gate. Foot and bicycle traffic is permitted beyond the gate.

title: Dedication Day Events: November 16 to 19, 2026
description: To commemorate the 250th Anniversary of the United States, this year's Dedication Day ceremony will fully recreate President Abraham Lincoln's visit to Gettysburg, beginning with his arrival by train on November 18. This will follow on November 19 with a recreation of the formal procession that will begin at the David Wills house, proceed down Baltimore Street, and enter the Taneytown Road gate of the Gettysburg National Cemetery. A full series of special events will take place from November 16 to 19.

title: Telephone Lines Will Be Transitioning Beginning November 16th
description: The preserve's telephone lines will soon be transitioning to a new system and we may be a few days without phone service. We will do our best to keep you informed as we work through the system. If you have an emergency, 911 services are available in our area. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Replace Bocce Ball Court Retaining Wall
description: Project work begins on Monday, February 9 to replace the bocce ball 50-foot retaining wall in order to improve existing infrastructure and enhance visitor safety. Several parking spots on lower Van Ness will be fenced off and the bocce ball court will not be accessible for the duration of the project, slated through November 2026. Please be aware of machinery, work, and signs.

title: River Mountains Loop Trail Covered by Flood Debris in Multiple Areas
description: Cyclists and hikers be aware that the trail is covered by sharp rocks and sand in places. The trail is impassable and closed along Lake Mead Parkway from mile 8.5 to 11. This closed portion is managed by the City of Henderson. It is unknown when this section of trail will be reopened. In the recreation area the trail between MM12-13 is not closed but has been damaged along the edge. This will be marked with cones. Keep away from cut banks as they could collapse without warning.

title: Kīpahulu District Campground is Open
description: The campground road will reopen tomorrow Tuesday, November 10. Campers please be mindful of the rough road and drive slow. Campers have the option to park in the overflow parking lot and walk in to your reserved site.

title: Phone Line
description: The park phone line is experiencing technical difficulties. To contact the park, please call 540-693-3241 or email frsp_info@nps.gov.

title: Oversized Vehicle Parking Limited
description: The main parking area at the Harry Hampton Visitor Center has limited parking for larger vehicles. The lot can fill quickly, especially on weekends. If traveling in an RV or larger vehicle, we recommend arriving early in the day. Please be aware, turning around may be challenging when the oversized vehicle parking lot is full. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Visitor Center Holiday Hours and Closures
description: The Capitol Reef visitor center will have shortened hours or be closed for the following holidays: November 25 closing at 1 pm. November 26, closed. December 24 and 25, closed. December 31 closing at 1 pm. January 1, closed.

title: Waterside Drive NW Road Closure Temporarily Delayed
description: The planned construction and temporary closure of Waterside Drive NW have been postponed. There is no construction detour currently in place. Construction is now expected to begin in Spring 2027.

title: Historic Homes Closed for Season
description: The historic homes are closed for the winter season and anticipated to open late spring/early summer. Park grounds are open daily sunrise to sunset. The Visitor Center is open 11am to 4pm Mondays through Fridays. The Visitor Center is closed Saturdays and Sundays. The Visitor Center is closed on wintertime federal holidays, except for Presidents Day.

title: Alcatraz Island Temporarily Closed for Dock Repairs October 26-November 18
description: Alcatraz Island, part of the Golden Gate National Recreation Area, is temporarily closed while crews replace pilings that secure the ferry dock to the island. Repairs are expected to be completed by November 18, 2026. For more information, please see news release linked here.

title: China Beach Construction & Seacliff Avenue Closures Fall - Winter 2026
description: Park's China Beach renovation of bathhouse, lower terrace, and picnic areas is in progress. See 'more' for link to Phase 3 of China Beach project below. SFPUC waterline replacement project will cause parking restrictions, lane closures, and access controls along Sea Cliff Avenue. Visitors should expect SFPUC project on Sea Cliff Avenue to impact access to China Beach. See link to SFPUC project below: https://www.sfpuc.gov/construction-contracts/construction-projects/seacliffpumps.

title: Fire Danger LOW
description: Fires are permitted in the campground and designated picnic areas. Please ensure that all fires are not left unattended and are completely extinguished. Fireworks are always prohibited. No roadside parking.

title: Cadillac Summit Road closed to all users Nov 9-25 and Dec 1-18
description: Starting Nov 9, construction will resume for an accessible pedestrian path between the East and West parking lots on the summit of Cadillac Mountain. Cadillac Summit Road will be closed to all users (including bicyclists and pedestrians) Nov 9-25 and Dec 1-18. Hiking trails on Cadillac Mountain will remain open. NOTE: Park Loop Road will close to motor vehicles for the season Dec 1, except for access to Jordan Pond via Jordan Pond Road in Seal Harbor, and access to Sand Beach via Schooner Head Road.

title: Park Phones are Down
description: We are currently not able to receive any calls Nov. 4 & 5th. Please email us at labe_information@nps.gov for any questions or information about the park. If you have an emergency, please call 911.

title: Roadwork begins Nov 16 - closures to S. Kelbaker Road, Kelso Dunes, more
description: Starting Monday, November 16th, major roadwork will begin. South Kelbaker Road will close between Kelso and the southern preserve boundary near I-40. Kelso Dunes, Kelso Dunes primitive camping area, and Granite Pass / Kelbaker Boulders primitive camping area will be closed until the South Kelbaker phase of the road project is completed.

title: Partial Trail Closure: Echo Bay (Nov. 6 - 22)
description: A portion of the Echo Bay Trail in Kabetogama will be temporarily closed Nov. 6–22 during hunting season. The closure affects the easternmost section of the trail and is intended to minimize conflicts between trail users and promote visitor safety. Closure signs will be posted along the affected trail sections. Visitors are asked to respect all posted closures during this time.

title: WILDFIRE CLOSURES: Sunrise & northern trails.
description: Due to several active fires on the north side of the park, the following closures are in effect until further notice: Grand Park area & trails, Northern Loop Trail, Wonderland Trail from Carbon River Suspension Bridge to Frozen Lake, & associated backcountry campgrounds. White River & Sunrise Roads have closed for the winter season.

title: SR 165 Carbon River/Fairfax Bridge is closed: no access to Carbon River or Mowich Lake.
description: There is NO public access to Carbon River & Mowich Lake from SR 165. The bridge is closed to pedestrians, bicycles and vehicles and there is no alternate route.

title: Frederick Law Olmsted National Historic is Seasonally Closed until May 2027
description: Frederick Law Olmsted NHS is seasonally closed through late May 2027. Off-season tours (November through late May) are available by appointment only on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with at least two weeks' advance notice. Tours are subject to staff availability; weekend tours are not available. Please email us for additional information.

title: All vehicles are required to carry tire chains.
description: All vehicles, including AWD & 4WD, are required to carry tire chains when traveling in the park during the winter season (November 1 - May 1). Choose the "more" link for tire chain requirement FAQs.

title: Current Park Closures
description: Closures may occur due to inclement weather, construction projects, or other emergency conditions. Please visit the linked page for information about current closures.

title: Isle Royale National Park to Reopen April 16, 2027
description: From November 1 - April 15 annually, Isle Royale and its surrounding islands are closed to all visitors. Lake Superior waters are open to navigation. All islands reopen April 16. Call (906) 482-0984 to discuss trip planning, obtain permits, or pay fees.

title: No Public Morning Trolley Runs on Select Dates
description: Due to scheduled education programs, the trolley will not be offering public runs on the following mornings: 11/4, 11/6, 11/12, 11/19, and 11/20

title: Going-to-the-Sun Road Seasonal Closure
description: Going-to-the-Sun Road is closed for the season at Avalanche Creek on the west side of the park. On the east side, the closure is located at Jackson Glacier Overlook. Travel on open sections of the road may change at any time due to winter weather conditions. Visitors should check road conditions before their arrival and be prepared for winter weather.

title: Reroute in Effect — Baraboo Segment
description: The Ice Age Trail is closed along Effinger Rd for repaving. Follow the posted detour, which directs hikers south from STH‑113 (Water St) on a paved path, then along Mill Race Dr to Manchester St. The closure is anticipated to last until October. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: Use Caution — Summit Moraine Segment
description: A timber harvest is under way in the Summit Moraine Segment immediately east of STH-45 for approximately one mile. Operations are anticipated to continue through mid-October. Heavy machinery may be present in the area. Remain on the Trail and use caution. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: Temporary Rolling Roadblocks on Pinnacle Road
description: Park staff will conduct rolling roadblocks along Pinnacle Road to remove fallen leaves from the roadway. Visitors may experience temporary traffic delays while crews work. Leaf removal will continue as needed to help keep the road safe while maintaining visitor access. Please use caution and allow extra travel time.

title: Temporary Closure of Park Areas at Request of US Secret Service
description: At the request of the United States Secret Service and to ensure necessary security and safety for the adjacent White House complex and its occupants, several designated areas of President's Park will be temporarily closed from approximately 12:00 a.m. on Sunday, November 1, 2026, until approximately 11:59 p.m. on Monday, November 30, 2026. For a closure map and more detailed information, please follow the link below.

title: Recreational Driving - Beach Entry May Be Closed At High Tide
description: The Wilderness beach entry (west of Smith Point County Park) may be closed two hours before and after high tide due to a small section of diminished beach west of the Wilderness Visitor Center. Drivers must obey all closure signage and stay a minimum 20 feet from the toe of the dune while driving. Call the Wilderness Visitor Center at 631-997-7832 Wednesday-Sunday, 9:00 am - 4:00 pm for current conditions. Check tides before your outing at the link below.

title: Rocks and Sand on Park Roads from Recent Storms
description: While all park roads are currently open, Lake Mead crews continue to clean debris off roadways around the park. Expect small rocks in the roadway and sand at wash crossings. Many of the rocks are sharp and can puncture a tire. Motorcyclists take special care to avoid these hazards, especially areas of soft sand on pavement.

title: Harmful Algae Bloom
description: Harmful Algae Blooms may be seen throughout Lake Mohave. To reduce health risks, the National Park Service recommends recreators limit body contact with these waters when algae is present. Please click here for pictures of this dangerous cyanobacteria and contact the Park at 702-293-8990 for updates on this advisory.

title: Visitor Centers are Closed for the Season
description: All park visitor centers have closed for the season. This includes the Houghton, Rock Harbor, & Windigo/Ozaagaateng Visitor Centers.

title: Pierce Stocking Scenic Drive Annual Closure
description: Pierce Stocking Scenic Drive is closed to vehicles for the winter and spring season. If you choose to hike the drive, stay alert for heavy equipment clearing trees and deep sand. Areas may be temporarily closed to hikers. Why is it closed? The drive is on an active dune. Winter storms and heavy snow can damage hundreds of trees. Strong winds blow deep sand atop walkways, parking lots, and the road itself.

title: Visitor Center Closed on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays
description: The Visitor Center will only be open Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday from 8:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m. The Visitor Center will also be closed on the following holidays: Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year's Day.

title: Parking Lot E Closed for Construction
description: Parking Lot E is closed for construction. The park is currently working to expand this parking area, and the lot will be closed while the expansion is being built. Visitors can still access the Mary Byrd Branch Trail and Quantico Cascades Trail by following trail reroute signs and parking vehicles in Turkey Run parking area. For your safety, please follow all closures and only park in designated parking spots.

title: Cave tours have closed for the 2026 season
description: Cave tours and the Oregon Caves visitor center have closed for the 2026 season. We look forward to seeing you all again around spring break 2027. Have a great winter!

title: Visitor Center Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays in Winter Months
description: Beginning November 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027 the visitor center and bookstore will be closed on Mondays and Tuesdays, but the historic ranch buildings will remain open seven days a week with normal winter hours of 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

title: Seasonal Changes to Visitor Services
description: Beginning November 1, 2026, Lindenwald, the Visitor Center, and park bookstore are closed for the season. Park grounds remain OPEN daily from 7 am to sunset. Guided house tours are anticipated to resume in late May or early June 2027. Visitors can continue exploring the park through the free NPS App, featuring the self-guided Wayside Loop – Martin Van Buren and Dogs of the NPS audio tours.

title: Nighttime Road and Trail Closures Begin Nov. 2
description: Beginning Nov. 2, Rock Creek Park will temporarily close some roads and trails at night for deer management. Closed areas will be identified by NPS staffed closures along with signage and/or temporary barricades. Please follow posted detours and never enter closed areas. This work helps protect the forest and wildlife. For closures, safety precautions, and answers, read our Deer Management FAQ (https://www.nps.gov/rocr/learn/management/white-tailed-deer-management.htm).

title: OSV Status
description: 10/30/26 MD OSV is OPEN to State Line. VA South OSV is OPEN. Beware of overwash conditions at high tides. The VA North OSV fishing mile is closed.

title: Bridge K on Kingsnake Trail Out
description: Bridge K on Kingsnake Trail is currently out, awaiting replacement. Please use extreme caution if going around this bridge, as it crosses a slough. Water here may be 2-3 feet deep, or deeper.

title: Chains Road and The Chains day-use area are temporarily closed
description: While there is no threat to public safety and the risk to the dam remains low, there was a discovery of several bore holes containing detonation cords along a restricted service road leading to Glen Canyon Dam. An Explosive Ordnance Disposal team assessed the site and determined the materials date back to the dam's original construction. The National Park Service, Bureau of Reclamation, and explosives experts have restricted access to the area while mitigation options are evaluated.

title: Reds Meadow Road is closed for the season
description: Reds Meadow Road, which provides access to Devils Postpile National Monument, is closed for the season.

title: Most Park Roads Closed to All Vehicles
description: Most roads are closed to prepare for commercially-guided snowcoach and snowmobile travel during the winter season, which will begin December 15 (weather depending). The road between the North and Northeast entrances is the only road open year-round to regular vehicles.

title: Traffic Delays - Gardner River High Bridge
description: Expect a single lane of traffic with up to 15-minute delays, 24 hours a day, seven days a week, from April 1 through November 24, 2026. Oversized/overweight vehicles (8'6"+ wide, 75'+ long, 80,000 lbs+ gross vehicle weight) will not be able to cross the bridge during this time.

title: Temporary Entrance to Visitor Center
description: As construction work continues in front of Monroe School (the park visitor center), visitors are asked to enter the building through the north door (to the right as you face the building). Use caution when crossing the streets from the visitor parking lot and do not enter the construction areas. Handicap parking is not available in the parking lot behind the building; instead, please use the marked temporary spots in front of the building.

title: Kīlauea eruption
description: Volcanic eruptions can be hazardous. Stay out of closed areas and monitor air quality. Eruptions can last a few hours and are often separated by pauses lasting several weeks.

title: No Winter Maintenance on Battlefield Trail
description: The battlefield trail is open year round, but receives no winter maintenance. There may be ice or snow on the trail. Please use caution.

title: Painted Desert Visitor Center Closed for Construction
description: A major construction project is underway at Petrified Forest National Park. The Painted Desert Visitor Center is currently being renovated and is expected to reopen in June 2027. Visitor center operations have been relocated to the Painted Desert Inn, two miles past the entrance station. The restrooms, restaurant, giftshop, and gas station are still operating during construction.

title: Tree Work with Parking Impacts on Jefferson St.
description: A project to replace declining trees will start on November 2 through November 20. Parking along the south side of Jefferson St. will be unavailable during the first week of work and may be intermittently unavailable during the remainder of the project. Please follow all all posted signs, traffic controls, and instructions from project personnel.

title: Rim Drive and North Entrance Road are CLOSED for the Season.
description: Winter road closures are in effect. The park's North Entrance Road, most of the Rim Drive, Cloudcap, and Pinnacles Road are closed to automobiles. The park's West and South Entrances are open, as is Hwy 62 through the park. These roads will not reopen until mid-June or early July depending on the snowpack.

title: Mineral King Road in Sequoia National Park Is Closed for the Season
description: The portion of Mineral King Road inside Sequoia National Park is closed for the winter season.

title: Bat Tests Positive for Rabies, Visitors Urged to Report Potential Contact
description: A rabid bat was found at Olympic National Park near Staircase Bridge on August 9th. At approximately 2 p.m., the bat swooped down onto an unidentified woman and was temporarily caught in her hair. This individual is at risk for rabies and should seek healthcare immediately, as well as contact the Mason County Health Department at 360-427-9670, ext. 405. More at the link.

title: Closures Due to Flood Damage
description: Some areas of the park including Walnut Canyon Desert Drive, Yucca Canyon Trail, and Slaughter Canyon Trail will remain closed after extensive flood damage. No backcountry permits will be issued until further notice. The main park road to the visitor center and cavern is open.

title: Geology Tour Road Temporarily Closed
description: The park received a significant amount of rain. Due to flooding, Geology Tour Road is temporarily closed. Please use caution while traveling on all other roads in the park.

title: Some Trails Closed in the Grant Grove Area Due to Prescribed Burn Activity
description: Firefighters conducted a prescribed burn in the vicinity of Grant Grove and the General Grant Tree. Smoke and flame may be visible in the area. This is normal. Areas and trails in and around the prescribed burn are closed until they are determined to be safe. They will be reopened once they are cleared of hazards. Click "more" to view a map showing all trail and area closures.

title: Staircase Developed Area is Open, Use Caution in Burned Areas
description: The Staircase developed area is open. The surrounding wilderness areas will remain closed as repair and recovery efforts continue. Use extreme caution when entering burned areas. Burned landscapes may contain falling trees and branches, loose boulders, unstable ground, stump holes, landslides, and debris flows. Changing conditions such as wind, rain, or storms can rapidly trigger hazards. Learn more on our Fire Conditions and Updates page.

title: Visitors to Rialto, Ruby Beach & Coastal Areas Cautioned Due to High Tides
description: Fall brings higher high tides, which can be dangerous and will cover some coastal routes completely. Always consult a tide chart and map. Be wary of sneaker waves and beach logs, which tides can move unexpectedly.

title: Ocean Beach No-Burn Season: November 1, 2026, through February 28, 2027
description: Beach fires are PROHIBITED during the no-burn season. Do NOT make fire rings using rocks, logs or other items. The no-burn season avoids burning during the Bay Area Air Quality Management District's Winter Spare the Air season.

title: Park Phones are Down
description: The park's phones are currently not working to call in. If you have questions, please email us at JODA_Interpretation@nps.gov. If it is an emergency dial 911.

title: Limited Drinking Water Filling
description: Limited drinking water filling is available during the winter season. Bring enough water with you for your visit.

title: Playalinda District: Parking Lot #8-13
description: Attention Visitors:Due to strong winds and sand and water on the road, the following areas of the Playalinda District of Canaveral National Seashore are temporarily closed to all visitor use, including driving, walking, and biking: The main Playalinda road north of Eddy Creek. Parking Lots #8-13 The beach north of Eddy Creek boardwalk No backcountry hiking permits will be issued during this closure. Please follow posted signs and staff directions and stay out of closed areas.

title: Cave Creek Campground has closed for the season.
description: Cave Creek Campground has closed for the 2026 season. Camping options will open back up around Memorial Day weekend 2027.

title: Program Schedule Changes Will go into Effect Starting November 1
description: Starting November 1, 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM tour tickets will be available for sale at 9:30 AM a month in advance. - Example: On November 1, all morning tickets for December will be available for sale.

title: No Potable Water in Park Campgrounds
description: There is no water available in any campground in Great Basin National Park. Water is available at the Great Basin Visitor Center and the Lehman Caves Visitor Center.

title: Creek Crossings on Medano Pass Primitive Road Have Deep and Swift Water
description: The park weather station measured 1.5 inches of rain overnight on 10/23/2026. Medano Creek is currently flowing at 28 cubic feet per second. These conditions have resulted in many of the 9 creek crossings on this 4WD only road to have swift moving water that is 3 or more feet deep on some of these crossings. Extreme caution is advised. NOTE this does not affect access to the Main Dunes Parking or Pinon Flats Campground, or Visitor Center areas of the park.

title: No Water at Hosmer Campground
description: Water at Hosmer Campground in the Summit District is shutoff due to a waterline break. Water is available 24-hours at Headquarters Visitor Center one mile up the road. At this point we don't have an estimate for when repairs will be complete.

title: Weekday Traffic Delays on Generals Highway North of Giant Forest
description: Due to removal of hazard trees along Generals Highway between Highway 180 and Giant Forest, there are traffic delays on weekdays from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Vehicles may experience delays of up to 30 minutes at each work site. There will not be delays on federal holidays.

title: Haleakalā Phones Not Working
description: The park’s phones are currently unable to accept incoming calls. For questions, please email HALE_INTERPRETATION@NPS.GOV or call 808-490-9870. This temporary cell phone is available to reach the park, but service may be intermittent.

title: Tall Grass Loop and Scenic Overlook Trails closed
description: For your safety, the Tall Grass Loop Trail and Scenic Overlook Switchback Trail are closed due to severe weather damage to Historic Building 15. A fenced area around the building is blocking access to these trails.

title: DeMartin Trail and Campground
description: As part of CalTrans work to develop a new highway route that is more stable and safer, they will be undertaking geotechnical drilling this fall and winter. Hikers and campers in the area will likely see and hear heavy equipment at work and hear noise associated with the drilling, which may be 24 hours/day at times. Redwood National and State Parks has worked with CalTrans to minimize the impacts to users of this area while keeping the trail and campground open and accessible.

title: Road Open To: Mile 3 (Park Headquarters)
description: The Denali Park Road is currently open to Mile 3, Park Headquarters. Snowy conditions beyond that point prevent vehicle travel, though pedestrian travel is permitted.

title: Reroute in Effect — Verona Segment
description: A reroute is in effect on the Verona Segment south of the Military Ridge Trail due to a collapsed culvert. Follow posted signage along the Military Ridge Trail and a local park path to bypass the affected area. The segment remains open via the designated reroute. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: Reroute in Effect — Southern Blue Hills Segment
description: A reroute is in effect on the Southern Blue Hills Segment between the southern boundary of the Rusk County Forest and Old 14 Rd. from November 1 through November 30 due to a private hunting closure. Follow posted signage along CTH-W and Old 14 Rd. to bypass the closed section. Do not enter the closed area. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: Partial Closure of River Road to Graball Landing
description: The entrance to River Road from Sharkey Road in Glendora, MS is closed due to a washout. Visitors can still access Graball Landing along River Road via Tippo Road. From Highway 49 E take Highway 8 E towards Grenada. Turn left on Tippo Road and then left on River Road, Graball Landing will be on your left. Use the same route to exit.

title: Trail Detour at Glover Archbold Trail at Rock Creek Park (Washington, DC)
description: The southern part of the Glover Archbold trail is closed due to aerial hazards caused by the trestle bridge. Work is being done to safely remove the bridge from the area to alleviate these hazards. Please obey any posted signs and do not enter the fenced off area.

title: Section of Trail Closed
description: Please note that the 1871 Trail beyond Alahaka Ramp is closed.

title: McQueen's Island Trail Closed Beginning August 3, 2026
description: The McQueen's Island Trail will close for a Chatham County restoration project beginning August 3, 2026.

title: All lava tube caves closed November 1 through April 30
description: All park lava tube caves are closed for the winter from November 1 through April 30 to protect hibernating bats.

title: No overnight parking on Tioga & Glacier Point Roads
description: Overnight parking is not allowed on Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road, including all parking lots reachable from these roads.

title: Echo Park Road and Campground Closure
description: Echo Park Road is temporarily closed to motorized vehicles from the junction with the Harpers Corner Road to Echo Park Campground due to significant storm damage. The Echo Park Campground is also temporarily closed to camping due to road damage.

title: Oakland Main House Self-Guided Tours
description: The interior of the Oakland Main House is ONLY open to the public on Saturdays and Sundays from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. All tours of the house are self-guided and occupancy within the building is limited. Please plan accordingly.

title: Sectioned Trail Closures November 2-20
description: The park will be conducting forestry operations targeting hazard trees along Mountain Road, Upper Meadow Road, Sugarhouse Loop, McKenzie Road, and Prosper Trail November 2 - 20. During felling operations, sections of the trails marked in yellow may be temporarily closed for visitor safety. Closures may last up to one hour. Please observe all posted closure signs and barriers. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation.

title: Mansion ADA lift is currently not functional
description: Mansion ADA lift is currently not functional. Accessibility to the mansion will be limited to those with the ability to climb 3-4 steps into the first floor.

title: Winter Conditions throughout the Monument
description: Please be advised that trees are down on monument trails and will not be assessed until next spring. Slippery conditions are present throughout the monument and trails and walkways may have ice. Hike and travel with extreme caution.

title: Government Wash and 8.0 Mile Road Anticipated Reopening
description: The Government Wash campground and 8.0 Mile Road are anticipated to reopen in late November to vehicle access and overnight camping. This alert will be updated once the reopening date has been set.

title: Potential Delays Due to Area Construction
description: Visitors traveling on South Puerto Blanco Drive should use extreme caution due to increased traffic and ongoing construction along the road leading to Quitobaquito. Please observe the posted 25 mph speed limit.

title: Dump Station Closed for Season
description: The dump station has closed due to early freezing temperatures. Please make other arrangements. Drinking fountains are also in the process of being winterized for the same reason. Please plan appropriately.

title: Park closed Tuesdays & Wednesdays
description: Winter hours are currently in effect. El Morro is open 5 days/week, Thursday - Monday from 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Mountain Time. Closed on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Hiking park trails when the monument is closed is not permitted.

title: Water in campground is shut off for the winter
description: Due to overnight freezing temperatures, water in the campground has been shut off for the season. Visitors should plan to bring their own water. Small containers may be filled at the visitor center during business hours.

title: Active Closure
description: Due to recent wildlife interactions and out of an abundance of caution, the Naked Creek backcountry zone is closed to all recreation until further notice. A camping closure remains in effect for the Appalachian Trail (AT) from Lewis Mountain to Big Meadows, including the Bearfence AT Hut. The AT is still accessible to hikers for day-use only.

title: Bridge Work
description: On Monday, October 19, work will be taking place on the bridge leading into the park. Please use caution while driving and watch for workers in the area. The park will remain accessible to visitors. Thank you for your understanding

title: Parts of Santa Rosa Island Closed During Wildfire Recovery
description: Burned areas on Santa Rosa Island remain closed. Backcountry beach camping in Southeast Quadrant will remain closed for the remainder of the 2026 recreation season. Click the more link for additional information.

title: Toxic Algae May Be Present In Blue Mesa Reservoir
description: Cyanotoxin levels in the Blue Mesa Reservoir are now below state thresholds. Toxins are still present at low levels, therefore keep kids and pets out of the water. Avoid all contact with algae. If exposed, shower immediately.

title: Blackland Prairie Section Closed South of the Chickasaw Village Site
description: The Blackland Prairie section of the Scenic Trail south of the Chickasaw Village Site (milepost 261.8) is temporarily closed due to construction of the new access road to the Chickasaw Heritage Center. Construction activities and heavy equipment are operating within the trail corridor. There is no access through the construction area. Hikers approaching from either direction must turn around at the closure point. Please obey all posted closure signs and stay out of active construction zones for your safety.

title: Plan Ahead for 2027 Construction
description: Plan ahead for construction in 2027. Check road construction and park construction pages for more information.

title: No Water Available in Park
description: Water systems throughout the park have been shut off for the winter season, October to April. Please plan ahead and bring your own drinking water.

title: Visitor Center Contact Phone Down
description: The Theodore Roosevelt Birthplace contact phone, (212) 260-1616, is currently experiencing issues. Rangers may not be able to receive your call. For questions, please email thrb_info@nps.gov.

title: All Tickets are First-Come, First Served; We Cannot Take Reservations
description: All tickets to the Truman Home are first-come, first-served. At this time, we are unable to take any reservations for groups. No tickets are issued at the Truman Home itself...all tickets issued at the visitor center.

title: Lift to porch is unavailable
description: The lift to the porch of the Garfield Home is currently unavailable. We apologize for the inconvenience.

title: Kīpukapuaulu Trail Closed Due to Hazardous Trees and Hanging Limbs
description: Kīpukapuaulu Trail remains closed due to numerous hazardous trees and hanging limbs resulting from several recent storms. Managers are developing a plan and will reopen the trail when it is safe.

title: Use Caution — Skunk and Foster Lakes Segment
description: Logging operations are occurring in the Skunk and Foster Lakes State Natural Area on the west side of North Foley Rd. Heavy machinery may be present. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: David Wills House Closure
description: The David Wills House is currently closed. The house will temporarily reopen from November 16 to 19, 2026. Please visit our David Wills House web page for more information and a 3D tour of the house.

title: Single Lane Closures on South Parkway Near River Farm Drive
description: Beginning October 8, one lane both northbound and southbound will be closed 24 hours a day and 7 days a week for 4 weeks to repair an upheaval in the road. Please expect slight traffic delays in the area.

title: Tours by appointment unavailable on certain dates in November - January
description: Tours by appointment are not available on the following dates: November: 6-13, 25-27 December: 24-25, 31 January: 1-8

title: Planning a Fall visit to the Montgomery Interpretive Center? Read this!
description: The Montgomery Center is located next to the ASU football stadium. Home games are scheduled for Sept. 5 & 26, Oct. 9 (Fri), Nov. 14, 21 & 26 (Thur). Home games are big events - streets may be closed and parking may be difficult to find at this center.

title: Bridge to Maryland Heights & C&O Canal CLOSED
description: Due to safety concerns, the Goodloe Byron Memorial Footbridge to the C&O Canal NHP towpath is expected to remain closed this fall for safety repairs on the pedestrian bridge. This work is in addition to the staircase replacement. A shuttle with very limited space currently runs between Harpers Ferry NHP Visitor Center and C&O Canal Lock 34. This will impact access to Maryland Heights, the Appalachian NST, and the Potomac Heritage NST. We strongly advise considering other trails when possible.

title: Campground Closed for the Season
description: As of October 15, 2026 the campground is closed. The campground will reopen mid May of 2027.

title: McFadden Farm Trail Connection to Stones River Greenway Closed
description: The trail connecting the McFadden Farm Unit and the Stones River Greenway will be closed to the public while Tennessee Department of Transportation crews work to widen the North Thompson Lane bridge across the West Fork of the Stones River. Work is expected to be completed in 2030. Visitors may still access the McFadden Farm unit via Van Cleve Lane and use the historic McFadden Lane Trail to access interpretive exhibits.

title: Special Event: September 19 and 25, 2027 Scenic Drive temporary closure
description: Reef Ride Bike Days: For this special event the Scenic Drive will be open to bicycles and pedestrians only for part of the day on Saturday, September 18 and Saturday, September 25, 2027. The road will be closed to vehicles from sunrise to 3pm to allow for bicycles and pedestrians to enjoy the road at a more leisurely pace. The Fruita area and main road through the park (UT highway 24) - will remain open and unaffected by this closure.

title: Fall 2026 Prescribed Fire Notice at Lake Roosevelt
description: Lake Roosevelt National Recreation Area may implement the following prescribed burn during fall 2026.

title: Construction on HWY 26/89/191
description: Construction taking place on US HWY 26/89/191 south of Moran Junction. Expect 20-minute delays in both directions.

title: Operating Hours
description: The seashore is currently operating on the hours of 6:00 AM - 6:00 PM. Last entry into the seashore is at 5:00 pm.

title: Temporary Closure of El Morro Dry Moat to Santa Elena Bastion
description: The temporary closure of El Morro Dry Moat to Santa Elena Bastion is necessary to ensure public health and safety and security during the completion of the San Fernando Bastion cliff stabilization project.

title: Eastern National Bookstore is Closed
description: The Eastern National Bookstore and Gift Shop is closed until further notice. Please continue to check our website for updates.

title: Sulphur Banks Bridge Closed; Boardwalk is Open
description: The Sulphur Banks Bridge is damaged and closed until further notice. The Haʻakulamanu area, boardwalk and Sulphur Banks Trail are open and accessible from the west side near Steam Vents.

title: Upper Cliff Dwelling Tour Reservations Not Available
description: We are currently not taking reservations for our Upper Cliff Dwelling tours. The trail has been damaged due to the Monsoon season. For updated information please visit our website or the parks Facebook page.

title: Parking impacted due to the Legacy Restoration Fund Project
description: The Lower Farm parking lot near the Mule Barn is closed due to the Legacy Restoration Fund Project. The Upper parking lot located near the Orangery has reduced capacity due to a partial closure because of the Legacy Restoration Fund Project. To learn more about parking at Hampton NHS, click the link or visit the alerts page and then scroll down to the area that talks about parking.

title: Trail Closure for Restoration
description: The south portion of the Headland Trail is closed due to ongoing restoration work. Access to the trail will now close at 2:30 pm daily. All hikers must be off the trails by 4:45 pm.

title: Eastern Section of Beech Mountain Loop Trail Closed for Repairs
description: Starting Sept 21, the eastern section of the Beech Mountain Loop Trail will be closed for repairs from a junction just beyond the parking lot to just below the summit at the fire tower. Three alternate routes to the summit are available: the outer loop of the Beech Mountain Loop Trail, Beech South Ridge Trail and Beech West Ridge Trail.

title: ORV Permits Sold Online
description: Starting May 1st, 2026 ORV permits will only be able to be purchased online. Please visit the link to learn more.

title: Park Bookstore Update
description: The park bookstore is currently transitioning to a new partner. The park is working to identify and establish a new bookstore provider, and additional information will be shared as it becomes available. Due to this transition, a bookstore with items for purchase will not be in service until a new partner is established. Thank you for your patience during this transition.

title: Watchman Trail closed
description: The Watchman Trail is closed pending repairs.

title: Seasonal Closure: Bush Key
description: Most of Bush Key is now open to the public. To protect nesting frigatebirds, a small area on the north side of Bush Key, all of Long Key, and all vegetation remains closed until further notice.

title: Temporary Closure of the Lloyd W. Smith Gallery in the Museum
description: The Lloyd W. Smith Gallery will be closed temporarily due to construction. All other exhibits will remain open.

title: Hunting Season Safety
description: Hunting is allowed in parts of Apostle Islands National Lakeshore from mid-September through early January. Wear blaze orange to stay visible and keep pets leashed and in bright vests. Make noise while hiking so others can hear you. Stay aware and enjoy a safe visit. Click the link below for more information on hunting and trapping in the Lakeshore.

title: Fort Moultrie Fishing Dock Closure
description: The Fort Moultrie Fishing Dock is currently under construction and closed to the public.

title: Rainbow Park Closure
description: The Rainbow Park Road, Rainbow Park Campground, and Rainbow Park Boat Ramp are closed as of September 25, 2026 due to significant storm damage until repairs are completed, likely through spring of 2027. The 3/4-mile Rainbow Park Road is closed to vehicles from the junction with the Island Park Road to the Rainbow Park Campground and boat ramp. The Island Park Road remains open to Ruple Ranch.

title: Round Spring Pavilion Parking Area Closed
description: The parking lot for the Round Spring Pavilion and for Round Spring itself is CLOSED for the remainder of 2026 while the low water bridge over Spring Valley Creek is rebuilt. Alternative parking near Round Spring Group Campsites 4-8 will provide trail access to the north side of Round Spring.

title: Natural Entrance Tour Route Closes For Season October 1, 2026
description: The Natural Entrance Tour Route will be closed for the season beginning October 1st, 2026. The Garden of Eden, Fairgrounds, and Accessibility Tour Routes remain available. This annual closure will last through the winter season.

title: Temporary Closure of the Clara Barton Parkway 3500 ft of right travel lane
description: Temporary Closure of the Clara Barton Parkway 3500 feet of right travel lane at Site 17, managed land areas between Clara Barton Parkway and C&O Canal, and between Lock 10 parking lot north to Lock 14 required to address the ongoing safety concerns from DC Water emergency sanitary sewer bypass and pipe repair. Click on "More" below for specific details on the closure.

title: Use Caution — Milwaukee River Segment
description: Logging operations are occurring along a 0.3‑mile section of the Trail about 0.2 miles north of Hwy 28. Work may continue into winter. Heavy machinery may be present. Use caution. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: Reroute in Effect — Sand Creek Segment
description: A 0.6‑mile section on the western side of the Sand Creek Segment is closed October 15–December 1 for private hunting. Follow posted reroute directions to bypass this area. The 3.9‑mile bypass route replaces 2.4 miles of Ice Age Trail/connecting route. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: Hunting Season Begins
description: Hunting in Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument is now open for the 2026 season. Hunting is permitted on all monument land east of the East Branch Penobscot River. It is recommended that all visitors wear high visibility clothing regardless of their location within the monument until hunting seasons concludes. For more information about recreational hunting in the monument, please click below.

title: Vehicle Break-in and Theft Warning
description: Do not leave valuables in your car. As a last resort, lock items in your trunk before arriving. Thieves target parking lots and break-ins can occur.

title: Reroute in Effect — Averill‑Kelly Creek Wilderness Segment
description: A one‑mile section on the eastern side of the Averill‑Kelly Creek Segment is closed October 15–December 31 for private hunting. Follow posted reroute directions. The entire segment is also closed during the 9‑day gun deer season. For maps and additional details from the Ice Age Trail Alliance, follow the link below:

title: NPS Visitor Wi-Fi
description: Visitor Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi calling is now available in the Kelso Depot parking lot for calls including emergencies. Go to the bulletin board at the Kelso Depot restrooms for instructions.

title: Annual and lifetime passes not available for purchase
description: Annual and lifetime passes are not currently available for purchase at Puʻuhonua o Hōnaunau National Historical Park. As an alternative, you can purchase an annual pass online.

title: Construction Begins on East Brotherton Road in Chickamauga Battlefield
description: Beginning September 23, the national military park will close East Brotherton Road, between Alexander's Bridge Road and Jay's Mill Road, for construction within Chickamauga Battlefield. During this period, all public traffic will be prohibited on the closed portion of the road. The park asks that visitors and commuters make necessary arrangements and select alternative routes to avoid this section of the road. Thank you for your continued understanding and patience as this project is completed.

title: The Park is Closed on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year's Day each year.
description: Fort Union National Monument is CLOSED on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year's Day each year. The closure includes all park grounds and facilities.

title: Partial Trail Closures on Bailly / Chellberg Trail
description: Portions of Bailly / Chellberg Trail (with stairs) will be closed through October (10/30/26), to allow completion of boardwalk replacement project.

title: Towpath Trail between Boston and Peninsula
description: Closed from Boston Trailhead to Lock 29, August 24–November 20, 2026 and March 29–April 21, 2027.

title: Hunting Season Underway: Oct 1 to Feb 28
description: All units except the Turkey Creek Unit allow hunting. In hunting areas, hunting is not allowed within 500 feet of trails. Wear orange if entering a hunting area.

title: The Oaks is Temporarily Closed Due to Preservation Work
description: The Oaks, the historic home of Booker T. Washington is closed to visitors due to an ongoing preservation and rehabilitation project. The project will be completed in phases, with Phase 1 focused on restoration and preservation, including exterior improvements to the historic home. Phase 1 is expected to be completed in December 2026.

title: Camping and Docking at Boca Chita and Elliott Keys
description: Day Use Docking at Boca Chita and Elliott Keys: $25.00 Friday - Monday and Federal Holidays. Overnight Camping and Docking at Boca Chita and Elliott Keys: $60.00 per night. Payments must be made on site using the recreation.gov phone app.

title: Apple Picking will not be Available for the 2026 Season.
description: A limited yield was expected this year but as particular varieties approached their ideal ripeness, virtually no apples were present. Learn more about the historic orchard.

title: Large vehicle restrictions on Zion-Mt. Carmel Highway
description: Vehicles that exceed length, width, height, or weight limits cannot travel between Canyon Junction and the park's East Entrance. See the current limits on the page linked below.

title: Toxic cyanobacteria in rivers, streams, and pools
description: Do not submerge your head in or drink instream water in Zion National Park.

title: Angels Landing Pilot Permit Program
description: All hikers need a permit to hike Angels Landing. Learn why you need a permit and how to get one using the link below.

title: Please park legally and responsibly
description: Zion has limited parking. Once parking spaces in Zion are full, visitors should park in Springdale. Please park only in designated spaces. Vehicles parked outside of designated spaces are subject to citation and towing.

title: Overlook Park Parking Lot - Vehicles Must Be Parked in a Designated Spot
description: Parking is extremely limited on weekends & event days. Overflow parking is available at the Paterson Museum, located at 2 Market Street. On weekends only, additional parking is available at the lot across from the Museum.

title: Increased Bear Activity in the Riverway
description: Bears have been seen approaching campsites in the Riverway in search of food. Store all food, garbage, and scented items in bear‑resistant containers, locked vehicles, or properly hung bags. Food should never be stored in tents. Stay alert and report safety concerns to 1‑800‑PARK‑TIP

title: Fall Hunting Seasons
description: Michigan has many designated hunting seasons for different animals. Several of these hunting seasons overlap and begin mid-September. Hunting is permitted within Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore in accordance with Michigan state laws and regulations. Hunting is not permitted within 450 feet of popular sites within the park, which are listed in the Superintendent's Compendium. Wearing brightly colored clothing is recommended for visitors.

title: Hazardous Conditions at Terminus Of Aialik Glacier
description: Entering an ice fall hazard zone is prohibited in Kenai Fjords National Park. The terminus of Aialik Glacier is a high-risk area, where unstable ice can fall in blocks or columns. This can generate localized tsunami waves that wash over newly deglaciated and nearby beaches. Rapidly collapsing ice and breakage can cause severe injury or death.

title: Site Closure – Adams Farm at Penn’s Hill
description: The Adams Farm at Penn’s Hill (John Adams and John Quincy Adams Birthplaces) is closed due to a major landscape treatment project. During construction, the entire site will be inaccessible. The Visitor Center and Peace field remain open and accessible.

title: INNER CANYON WATER SHUTOFFS
description: Beginning Sep. 6, no potable water will be available in the inner canyon, including along the Bright Angel Trail (1.5 Mile Resthouse, 3-Mile Resthouse, Havasupai Gardens day use and campground). All backpackers and hikers should carry water filtration and treatment OR carry all water with them.

title: Elevator is Out-of-Service
description: The elevator at the Visitor Center is currently out-of-service, due to regularly scheduled maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience and encourage visitors to visit the virtual tours available on our website.

title: North Parking Lot at Osceola Landing to Close for Bridge Construction
description: The northernmost parking lot and co-located boat ramps at Osceola Landing will close week of 9/14 as part of the Hwy 243 Osceola Bridge replacement project. The parking lot and boat ramps will be used as a staging area and river access point for construction equipment for the duration of the Hwy 243 bridge replacement project. During this time, the rest of Osceola Landing will be open for visitor use including alternative parking lots, restrooms, picnic shelters, trail, and other river access points.

title: Burnwood Campground and Restroom Closure
description: The Burnwood group campground will be closed from October 5 through mid November due to a construction project to replace water lines. During that time restroom facilities will be closed at the Burnwood Trailhead.

title: Temporarily Closed for Construction
description: The Council House is closed for the rehabilitation of the home’s exterior and interior and to clean the home’s historic artifacts. The building and grounds will be closed from 9:00 a.m. September 9, 2026 until 9:00 a.m. January 27, 2027

title: Kennesaw Mountain Dr. Closed to Private Vehicles, Limited Cycling Permitted
description: The road to the top of Kennesaw Mountain is now closed to private vehicles. Shuttle service to the top of the mountain is available 7 days a week for free, parking fees still apply. Cycling is now permitted to the top of the mountain in designated lane during designated hours. Cyclist Hours: Summer: 7:30–9:30 AM & 4:30–8:30 PM Winter: 7:30–9:30 AM & 4:30–6:30 PM

title: Reservations Only at Buffalo Point - Starting March 15, 2027
description: Starting March 15, 2027, reservations will be required for all campsites at Buffalo Point Campground, including A & E Loops. Reservations must be made through Recreation.gov (www.recreation.gov) or by calling 877-444-6777. Reservations can be made the same day or up to six months in advance. Please note that cell phone service is unreliable in these areas, so it is strongly recommended to make your reservation before arriving at the campground.

title: Winter Hours Begin September 14
description: Winter Operating Hours in effect September 14, 2026: the visitor center is open five days a week, Wednesday through Sunday, closed on Monday and Tuesday.

title: Fort Donelson NB Park Fall Hours
description: Visitor Access to Fort Donelson NB Park Lands: Pedestrian Access is from sunrise to sunset. Automobile Access to Fort Donelson NB Park Roads 8:00 am – 6:00 p.m. daily.

description: BY MONTH 2026 CLOSURE DATES JANUARY8 (THU) FEBRUARY3 (TUE) MARCH4 (WED) APRIL6 (MON) MAY7 (THU) JUNE2 (TUE) JULY8 (WED) AUGUST3 (MON) SEPTEMBER16 (WED) OCTOBER5 (MON) NOVEMBER5 (THU) DECEMBER8 (TUE)

description: The monument is also closed for the holidays on July 4 and Dec 25 each year. BY MONTH 2026 CLOSURE DATES for Maintenance.
